description: Java class defining a custom exception SubscriptionProtocolErrorException for handling protocol errors in subscriptions within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for creating instances from causes or JSON, and a builder class for constructing instances.

classes.name: SubscriptionProtocolErrorException
classes.description: Custom exception class for subscription protocol errors, extending DittoRuntimeException and implementing ThingSearchException.

classes.name: Builder
classes.description: Mutable builder class for constructing SubscriptionProtocolErrorException instances with a fluent API.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an exception instance from a Throwable cause and DittoHeaders.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Returns a new builder instance for constructing the exception.

methods.name: getEmptyBuilder
methods.description: Provides an empty builder for the exception.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs an exception from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated DittoHeaders.
